description: The image presents a series of three pie charts representing problem distributions across three difficulty levels labeled "easy," "medium," and "hard," with the text "CoT" centered below the medium chart. Each of the three charts consists of four slices corresponding to a shared legend located on the far right. The legend defines the categories by color: N+K+ (teal), N-K+ (tan), N-K- (light orange), and N+K- (red-orange). Percentage labels are displayed directly inside each slice in black text, and none of the segments are exploded, offset, or visually emphasized. In the "easy" chart, the largest slice is tan (N-K+) at 45.9%, followed by teal (N+K+) at 40.6%, light orange (N-K-) at 10.1%, and red-orange (N+K-) at 3.3%. The "medium" chart shows the teal (N+K+) slice at 44.6%, tan (N-K+) at 44.3%, light orange (N-K-) at 7.2%, and red-orange (N+K-) at 3.9%. Finally, the "hard" chart displays the light orange (N-K-) slice at 36.8%, tan (N-K+) at 36.2%, teal (N+K+) at 20.1%, and red-orange (N+K-) at 7.0%. Visually, the segments are not ordered by descending or ascending size; instead, they maintain a consistent counter-clockwise sequence of teal, tan, light orange, and red-orange across all three charts.
